subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e**. 'Who'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4 is** "who".**
 
• In this context,** "who" **is used as a relative pronoun to introduce a clause that provides more information about the subject, Salvador's brother.
 
• The** sentence says** Salvador had a brother named Salvador who was born nine months before him.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: *'Salvador Dali was a prominent Spanish surrealist painter born in Figueres, Catalonia, on 11 May 1904. Dali's father was strict in the education of his children unlike his mother. Dali had a brother named Salvador **who** was born nine months before him and died of gastroenteritis. When he was five. Dali was taken to his brother's grave and was told that he was his brother's (5) _______.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options don't fit:
 
 
• **"Whose"** is a possessive relative pronoun used to indicate ownership or relationship, which doesn't fit in this context.
 
• **"Whom"** is used as the object of a verb or preposition, and it's not the case here.
 
• **"That"** can sometimes be used as a relative pronoun, but generally not when referring to a specific person by name.
